Dialogue with European Mapping Company TomTom: Chinese Orders Soar Tenfold, Aiding Chinese Assisted Driving to Go Global | Frontline

May 25, 2026 徐蔡钰 (36Kr) TomTom, Chinese automakers, overseas expansion, ADAS, intelligent driving, Orbis Maps, navigation, Huawei Petal Maps, Tencent, automotive globalization
Read the source article

Quick summary

TomTom executives reveal that Chinese-related orders have surged tenfold from 2024 to 2025, positioning the European map provider as a critical enabler for Chinese automakers' intelligent driving expansion into global markets.

Key takeaways

  • TomTom reports a 10x increase in China-related orders from 2024 to 2025, with 100,000 vehicles equipped with TomTom services exported overseas in Q1 2026 alone.
  • Chinese automakers (BYD, Chery, XPeng, NIO, Li Auto, Xiaomi) need specialized overseas map data for navigation, ADAS, compliance, and intelligent cockpit — not just cost-competitiveness.
  • TomTom's global data coverage spans 235 countries, with independently controlled base map data rather than SDK-only solutions — a key differentiator for cross-regional standardization.
  • TomTom partners with Huawei Petal Maps (navigation software) and Tencent (intelligent driving) in a co-creation model, acting flexibly as data provider, service provider, or full-solution tier-1.
  • The company achieved a six-month mass production timeline on a Chinese automaker project and plans large-scale European deployment of traffic light countdown recognition (co-developed with Huawei) in H2 2026.
